title: The roadmap build scores each step, and a triage agent checks the top at each batch merge
why: The queue order drifts when triage forgets the c55 re-weigh; the owner wants it to fix itself.
source: owner 11:24 CST Nov 12 via the retrospective (session_013NEJKz5AWFJhGvmCUoi6wQ, 11:26 and 11:28 CST): "this is good approved: (d) Score plus agent (recommended)"
note: Ruled option (d): the roadmap build gives each step a score from facts it already holds: it cites an owner ruling, how long it has been ready, how many steps wait on it, and whether the owner flagged it. At each batch merge a triage agent checks the top of that order and may move a step, with a one-line reason. Not picked: (f), the lane-start check. Home: decision session-tiers (the triage role); the lane writes the re-rank rule there beside c55, with the owner's words and time. Reads live statuses, so it waits on step upkeep-keys-live-status. The page pass at each batch merge (open threads, republish on a template change, re-sort) rides the same trigger. Replaces the hand re-weigh in plans/reweigh-2026-11-12. Ready, no lane.
